mutations.name: evidence at any head counts
mutations.find: WHERE repo = ? AND head = ? AND gate = ?
mutations.replace: WHERE repo = ? AND (head = ? OR 1) AND gate = ?
kills: a lan-gates hold released by gate evidence stays held when every gate is green only at a head the PR has moved past

mutations.name: a red record counts as green
kills: a lan-gates hold released by gate evidence stays held when the newest record for one gate at the head is red, even after an earlier green one

mutations.name: one green gate is enough
kills: a lan-gates hold released by gate evidence stays held while one named gate has no record at the head

mutations.name: green evidence never releases
kills: a lan-gates hold released by gate evidence releases once every named gate is green at the PR's exact head, recording that head on the release

mutations.name: a named reviewer is passed over
kills: a lan-gates hold released by gate evidence stays held when the hold names a reviewer, whose verdict it waits for
